closing.title: Running a walk-in soon?
closing.body: Tell us your roles and cities and we'll set up your first drive with you.

c.a: Yes. Finding a walk-in and getting a token is free.

c.q: Can I get a token from home?
c.a: No. Tokens are given at the venue. When check-in opens, scan the QR code on the lobby display and your place in line shows on your phone.

c.q: What happens if I miss my call?
c.a: Go to the front desk within 10 minutes of the call. They can put you back in line.

c.q: How is the wait time worked out?
c.a: From the number of people ahead of you and how long recent interviews at that drive have taken. It changes as rounds move.

c.q: What if I can't make it?
c.a: Open your token and tap "I can't make it". Your place goes to the people behind you.

k.q: How do we list a walk-in?
k.a: Create a drive with the role, venue, date and time, rounds and documents. Turn on the public listing and it shows on the walk-in list.
Recruiters who read resumes, write notes and record decisions sign in with their work email. Front-desk staff can call and check in candidates with a Desk PIN, no account needed.

k.q: Can we run several rooms and rounds at once?
k.a: Yes. Add as many rounds and rooms as you need. Each recruiter calls the next person into their own room.
They scan the QR code on the lobby display at the venue. That gives them a token and puts them in line.

k.q: Can we export to our ATS?
k.a: Yes. Export a CSV or Excel file with name, phone, role, notes and the decision from every round.
Start with a pilot. Tell us about your drives and we'll talk through pricing with you.

howPage.title: How TokenHire works
howPage.sub: One queue, from the gate to the final round.

candidates.d: Search by role, company or city. Each listing shows pay, timing, the venue and what to carry.
Reach about 30 minutes before your slot with printed copies of your documents.
Scan the QR code on the lobby display. Your token number and place in line show on your phone.
Your phone shows how many people are ahead of you and tells you when you're about 5 away.
Go to the room on your screen and show your token at the door.

companies.d: Add the role, venue, date and time, pay and the documents to carry.
Add each round, the room it runs in and the recruiters on it.
Open it on a screen at the venue. Candidates scan its QR code to get a token.
Recruiters press Call next and the next person goes to their room. Front-desk staff can help with a Desk PIN.
Notes and decisions are saved against each round as you go.
Download a CSV or Excel file at the end of the day.

forCo.title: Run walk-ins without the chaos.
forCo.sub: If you hire in person, you know the day: hundreds of people, paper resumes, and nobody sure who's next. TokenHire gives you one queue and one clean file.

problem.title: What drive day looks like now

items.d: Everyone arrives at opening time and waits outside for hours.
Resumes get stacked, lost and typed into sheets late at night.
Names are shouted, some people are called twice and some never.
Every candidate gets a number at the venue and sees their place in line on their phone.
Each recruiter calls the next person into their room, round by round.
Front-desk staff call and check in candidates with a PIN. No account needed.
One clean file with name, phone, role, notes and every decision.
